title: Find Customer Referee
notes: Simple just read the question and apply constraints
code:
SELECT
    name
FROM 
    Customer
WHERE
    referee_id IS NULL OR referee_id != 2;

title: Big Countries
notes: Simple just read the question and apply constraints
code:
SELECT
    name, population, area
FROM
    World
WHERE
    area >= 3000000 OR population >= 25000000;
